steps.text: Talk to Willow on the path south of Ice Mountain, north of Falador.
Speak to Checkal in Barbarian Village near the pottery oven building.
Speak to Atlas in The Long Hall tavern in Barbarian Village and complete training.
Take some cooked meat and a beer from the tables in The Long Hall if you do not have them already.
Return to Checkal and use the Flex emote when prompted.

sections.title: Marley
notes: Items required: a knife, cooked meat and bread.

steps.text: Speak to Marley in Edgeville at the yew trees. You MUST speak to Marley first or the cook wont give you the recipe.
Speak to the cook in the east room of Blue Moon Inn in Varrock. He will give you the steak sandwich recipe.
chat: 1. I was wondering if you'd be able to make me a Steak sandwich?

steps.text: Create a steak sandwich by using a knife on cooked meat while having bread in your inventory.
Speak to Marley in Edgeville at the yew trees with the steak sandwich in your inventory.

sections.title: Burntof
notes: Items required: a beer or 3 coins.

steps.text: Speak to Burntof in the Rising Sun Inn in Falador.
If you do not have a beer, buy any beer for 3 coins by talking to Emily or Kaylee.
Choose any option in the game of rock paper scissors.

sections.title: Entering the dungeon
notes: Items recommended: Some food for low combat players, and any pickaxe or a weapon and armour to kill a level 25 monster.

steps.text: Go to the entrance of the Ruins of Camdozaal, at the west side of the Ice Mountain, and talk to Willow (dungeon icon on minimap).
After the cutscene, kill the level 25 Ancient Guardian by attacking it or mining the 4 structural pillars in the corners.
After the quest is complete, your character will speak with Ramarno, an Imcando dwarf found in the ruins.
